verdict.rationale: For a GPU accelerator, the public programmatic surface is ROCm. The documentation covers the HIP runtime and HIP C++ programming model, OpenMP, and AMD SMI as a user-space management and monitoring interface. It also documents automation surfaces: Prometheus-format metrics, a Kubernetes GPU Operator and device plugin, and container integration. An llms.txt index further aids AI-native consumption. missing for 10: evidence is only landing-page blurbs with no API reference depth shown (e.g., AMD SMI library/programmatic bindings not explicitly documented as an API), no OpenAPI-style spec, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the GPU via these APIs.
